initialPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop SaaS screen design as a flat, straight-on screenshot, not a photo, no device frame, no perspective. Landscape aspect close to 1586x992. This is a new FIRST-STORE SETUP surface in the SAME existing product as the supplied screenshot. Reference image is ONLY for the palette, sans-serif typography, tiny corner radii, thin gray-blue dividers and flat operational UI; do NOT copy its product table, SKUs, product images, giant sidebar, KPI blocks, or channel status list. Preserve navy #193c61, teal #247965, pale cool gray #f5f7fa and white; Arial/PingFang-like sans, never serif. Restrained professional composition, crisp legible Simplified Chinese. Main header brand: “直播商家工作台”; language menu top right “简体中文 ▾”, small separate “商家账号”. Clear visible small label “界面方案 · 演示内容”. It depicts a signed-in user creating an INTERNAL workspace, not a finished store. No fake statistics, price plans, testimonials, provider logos, connected channels, or claims that payments/logistics are available. Four fields and exact demo values: “所属商户” = “南岛生活”; “店铺名称” = “南岛选物”; “交易币种” = “TWD · 新台币”; “初始库存仓” = “境外备货仓”. Demo names are examples not verified businesses. Exact notice: “创建内部工作区，不会自动发布店铺或接通支付、物流。” A secondary small note below currency: “界面语言不会改变交易币种。” No decorative illustrations. Leave a comfortable amount of purposeful white space. All UI fits viewport, no bottom crop. Composition C: FOCUSED THREE-STEP WIZARD. Header height about68px. No sidebar, no receipt column. Centered focused form about760px wide with quiet large margins. At top “创建第一个工作区”. Horizontal three-step progress underneath: “1 商户资料” completed subtly; “2 店铺设置” active teal line; “3 库存仓” gray pending. Show only stage2, not all four fields. Above active inputs compact already-entered summary “所属商户：南岛生活” and understated “修改”. Main title within form “设置店铺名称与币种”. Two big labeled editable fields: “店铺名称” value “南岛选物”, “交易币种” dropdown “TWD · 新台币”; currency helper “界面语言不会改变交易币种。” Below fine divider footer: secondary text button “上一步” at left; single teal primary button “下一步：库存仓” at right. Exact scope notice visible below form. Small footer “完成全部资料后再创建工作区。” Display “界面方案 · 演示内容” subtly but clearly. Never show a final Create button on this middle step. No filled warehouse field because stage3 not yet reached. No A/B/C letters.
